mechanics.claim: The heal on Tongue Lash only occurs if the tongue hits an enemy champion, not any other target type.
mechanics.quote: If this hits an enemy champion, '''Tahm Kench''' also heals himself

mechanics.claim: Tahm Kench cannot move, attack, or cast Abyssal Dive/Devour (on a different target) while the Tongue Lash missile is in flight, delaying his next damage instance.
mechanics.quote: '''Tahm Kench''' is unable to move, attack, or cast {{ai|Abyssal Dive|Tahm Kench}} or {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} on a different target while his tongue is in flight

mechanics.claim: Devour can be queued during Tongue Lash's cast/travel and will not go on cooldown if Tongue Lash whiffs, allowing a fast follow-up cast.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Devour|Tahm Kench}} can be 'queued' at any point during ''Tongue Lash'' (including the wind-up animation) and will not go on cooldown if '''Tahm Kench''' fails to hit a valid target with ''Tongue Lash''
